title: Localization preserves finite presentation of modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S\subseteq R$ a multiplicative subset, and $M$ a finitely presented $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Then the localized module $S^{-1}M$ is finitely presented over $S^{-1}R$.
